name: TauCeti.geometricallyConnectedCommHopfAlgProperty_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem geometricallyConnectedCommHopfAlgProperty_iff
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (H : CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k) :
    geometricallyConnectedCommHopfAlgProperty k H ↔
      ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K],
        ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum ((H : Type v) ⊗[k] K))

name: TauCeti.geometricallyConnectedCommHopfAlgProperty_iff_idempotent_eq_zero_or_one
statement:
theorem geometricallyConnectedCommHopfAlgProperty_iff_idempotent_eq_zero_or_one
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (H : CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k) :
    geometricallyConnectedCommHopfAlgProperty k H ↔
      ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] (e : (H : Type v) ⊗[k] K),
        IsIdempotentElem e → e = 0 ∨ e = 1

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_map {H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R}
    (φ : H ⟶ K) :
    (forget₂ (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)).map φ =
      φ.hom

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_obj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_obj (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) :
    (forget₂ (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)).obj H =
      H.obj

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_fgAlgCat_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma forget₂_fgAlgCat_map {H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K) :
    (forget₂ (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (FGAlgCat.{v, u} R)).map φ =
      ObjectProperty.homMk (CommAlgCat.ofHom (toBialgHom φ).toAlgHom)

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_fgAlgCat_obj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma forget₂_fgAlgCat_obj (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) :
    (forget₂ (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (FGAlgCat.{v, u} R)).obj H =
      ⟨CommAlgCat.of R H, inferInstanceAs (Algebra.FiniteType R H)⟩

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.hom_ext
TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.ofHom_toBialgHom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ofHom_toBialgHom {H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R} (φ : H ⟶ K) :
    ofHom (toBialgHom φ) = φ

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.pointsFunctor_map_app_apply_apply
statement:
-- The point is ascribed to its algebra-map type by `show … from`, so that the application to `h`
-- elaborates through the `WithConv` synonym that `HopfAlgebra.points` carries.
@[simp]
lemma pointsFunctor_map_app_apply_apply {H K : (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)ᵒᵖ}
    (φ : H ⟶ K) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H.unop) A) (h : K.unop) :
    (show K.unop.obj →ₐ[R] A from
      (((pointsFunctor (R := R)).map φ).app A f).ofConv) h =
      f.ofConv (toBialgHom φ.unop (h : K.unop.obj))

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.pointsFunctor_obj
statement:
lemma pointsFunctor_obj (H : (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)ᵒᵖ) :
    (pointsFunctor (R := R)).obj H =
      HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor (R := R) (H := H.unop)

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom_comp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toBialgHom_comp {H K L : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R}
    (φ : H ⟶ K) (ψ : K ⟶ L) :
    toBialgHom (φ ≫ ψ) = (toBialgHom ψ).comp (toBialgHom φ)

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toBialgHom_id {H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R} :
    toBialgHom (𝟙 H : H ⟶ H) = BialgHom.id R H

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom_ofHom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toBialgHom_ofHom {H K : Type v} [CommRing H] [CommRing K]
    [_root_.HopfAlgebra R H] [_root_.HopfAlgebra R K]
    [Algebra.FiniteType R H] [Algebra.FiniteType R K] (φ : H →ₐc[R] K) :
    toBialgHom (ofHom (R := R) φ) = φ

name: TauCeti.finiteTypeCommHopfAlgProperty_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma finiteTypeCommHopfAlgProperty_iff {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) :
    finiteTypeCommHopfAlgProperty R H ↔ Algebra.FiniteType R H

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.includeLeft_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem includeLeft_apply (H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (h : H) :
    toBialgHom (includeLeft H K) h = h ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : K)

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.includeRight_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem includeRight_apply (H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (k : K) :
    toBialgHom (includeRight H K) k = (1 : H) ⊗ₜ[R] k

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.tensorProduct_finiteType
statement:
theorem tensorProduct_finiteType (A B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra.FiniteType R A] [Algebra.FiniteType R B] :
    Algebra.FiniteType R (A ⊗[R] B)

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeFunctor_map
statement:
@[simp]
lemma baseChangeFunctor_map {H L : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} k} (φ : H ⟶ L) :
    (baseChangeFunctor (K := K)).map φ = baseChangeMap (K := K) φ

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeFunctor_obj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma baseChangeFunctor_obj (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} k) :
    (baseChangeFunctor (K := K)).obj H = baseChange (K := K) H

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeIsoOfObjIso_hom
TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeMap_apply_tmul
TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_apply (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} k)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := K) (H := baseChange (K := K) H) A) (h : H) :
    (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) A H f).ofConv h = f.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] h)

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain
statement:
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain {H L : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} k}
    (φ : H ⟶ L) (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := K) (H := baseChange (K := K) L) A) :
    baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) A H
        (AlgHom.mapDomain (A := A) (toBialgHom (baseChangeMap (K := K) φ)) f) =
      AlgHom.mapDomain
        (A := _root_.TauCeti.CommAlgCat.restrictScalarsObj (algebraMap k K) A)
        (toBialgHom φ)
        (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) A L f)

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul
    (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} k)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := k) (H := H)
      (_root_.TauCeti.CommAlgCat.restrictScalarsObj (algebraMap k K) A))
    (s : K) (h : H) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) A H).symm f).ofConv (s ⊗ₜ[k] h) = s • f.ofConv h

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom_baseChangeMap
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toBialgHom_baseChangeMap {H L : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} k}
    (φ : H ⟶ L) :
    toBialgHom (baseChangeMap (K := K) φ) =
      _root_.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.map (_root_.BialgHom.id K K) (toBialgHom φ)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.hom_liftQuotient
statement:
lemma hom_liftQuotient (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker f.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom) :
    (liftQuotient I f hf).hom = Bialgebra.Quotient.liftBialgHom I.toIdeal f.hom hf

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.hom_mkQuotient
statement:
lemma hom_mkQuotient (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    (mkQuotient H I).hom = Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom I.toIdeal

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.kerOfSurjective_quotientMapOfLe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerOfSurjective_quotientMapOfLe (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    HopfIdeal.kerOfSurjective
        (Bialgebra.Quotient.liftBialgHom I.toIdeal
          (Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom J.toIdeal)
          (by simpa only [hom_mkQuotient] using
            toIdeal_le_ker_mkQuotient_of_le H hIJ))
        (quotientMapOfLe_surjective H hIJ) =
      J.map (Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom I.toIdeal)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.ker_quotientMapOfLe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_quotientMapOfLe {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k) {I J : HopfIdeal k H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    HopfIdeal.ker
        (Bialgebra.Quotient.liftBialgHom I.toIdeal
          (Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom J.toIdeal)
          (by simpa only [hom_mkQuotient] using
            toIdeal_le_ker_mkQuotient_of_le H hIJ)) =
      J.map (Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom I.toIdeal)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.liftQuotient_mk
statement:
lemma liftQuotient_mk (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker f.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom) (h : H) :
    (liftQuotient I f hf).hom (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) =
      f.hom h

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.liftQuotient_surjective_of_surjective
statement:
theorem liftQuotient_surjective_of_surjective (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker f.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective f.hom) :
    Function.Surjective (liftQuotient I f hf).hom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.liftQuotient_unique
statement:
lemma liftQuotient_unique (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker f.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom) (g : quotient H I ⟶ K)
    (hg : mkQuotient H I ≫ g = f) : g = liftQuotient I f hf

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_apply
statement:
lemma mkQuotient_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) (h : H) :
    (mkQuotient H I).hom h = Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_eqToHom
statement:
theorem mkQuotient_comp_eqToHom {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I = J) :
    mkQuotient H J ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (quotient H) hIJ.symm) = mkQuotient H I

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_liftQuotient
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mkQuotient_comp_liftQuotient (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker f.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom) :
    mkQuotient H I ≫ liftQuotient I f hf = f

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_quotientIsoOfComapEq_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mkQuotient_comp_quotientIsoOfComapEq_hom (e : H ≅ H) (I : HopfIdeal R H)
    (hI : I.comapOfSurjective e.hom.hom (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso e.hom).2 = I) :
    mkQuotient H I ≫ (quotientIsoOfComapEq e I hI).hom = e.hom ≫ mkQuotient H I

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_quotientIsoOfComapEq_inv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mkQuotient_comp_quotientIsoOfComapEq_inv (e : H ≅ H) (I : HopfIdeal R H)
    (hI : I.comapOfSurjective e.hom.hom (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso e.hom).2 = I) :
    mkQuotient H I ≫ (quotientIsoOfComapEq e I hI).inv = e.inv ≫ mkQuotient H I

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_quotientIsoOfIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mkQuotient_comp_quotientIsoOfIso_hom (e : H ≅ K) (I : HopfIdeal R K) :
    mkQuotient H (I.comapOfSurjective e.hom.hom (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso e.hom).2) ≫
        (quotientIsoOfIso e I).hom =
      e.hom ≫ mkQuotient K I

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_quotientIsoOfIso_inv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mkQuotient_comp_quotientIsoOfIso_inv (e : H ≅ K) (I : HopfIdeal R K) :
    mkQuotient K I ≫ (quotientIsoOfIso e I).inv =
      e.inv ≫ mkQuotient H
        (I.comapOfSurjective e.hom.hom (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso e.hom).2)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_quotientIsoOfSurjective_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mkQuotient_comp_quotientIsoOfSurjective_hom (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f.hom) (I : HopfIdeal R K) :
    mkQuotient H (I.comapOfSurjective f.hom hf) ≫ (quotientIsoOfSurjective f hf I).hom =
      f ≫ mkQuotient K I

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_quotientKerOfSurjectiveIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mkQuotient_comp_quotientKerOfSurjectiveIso_hom (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f.hom) :
    mkQuotient H (HopfIdeal.kerOfSurjective f.hom hf) ≫ (quotientKerOfSurjectiveIso f hf).hom =
      f

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_quotientMapOfLe
statement:
lemma mkQuotient_comp_quotientMapOfLe (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    mkQuotient H I ≫ quotientMapOfLe H hIJ = mkQuotient H J

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma mkQuotient_eq_zero_iff (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) (h : H) :
    (mkQuotient H I).hom h = 0 ↔ h ∈ I.toIdeal

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_hom_ext
TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_ker
statement:
lemma mkQuotient_ker (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    RingHom.ker (mkQuotient H I).hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom = I.toIdeal

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_surjective
statement:
lemma mkQuotient_surjective (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    Function.Surjective ⇑(mkQuotient H I).hom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientBotIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma quotientBotIso_hom (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) :
    (quotientBotIso H).hom =
      liftQuotient (⊥ : HopfIdeal R H) (𝟙 H) bot_le

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientBotIso_inv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma quotientBotIso_inv (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) :
    (quotientBotIso H).inv = mkQuotient H (⊥ : HopfIdeal R H)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientIsoOfIso_hom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma quotientIsoOfIso_hom_mk (e : H ≅ K) (I : HopfIdeal R K) (x : H) :
    (quotientIsoOfIso e I).hom.hom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk
          (I.comapOfSurjective e.hom.hom (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso e.hom).2).toIdeal x) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal (e.hom.hom x)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientIsoOfIso_inv_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma quotientIsoOfIso_inv_mk (e : H ≅ K) (I : HopfIdeal R K) (y : K) :
    (quotientIsoOfIso e I).inv.hom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I.toIdeal y) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R
        (I.comapOfSurjective e.hom.hom (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso e.hom).2).toIdeal
        (e.inv.hom y)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientIsoOfSurjective_hom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma quotientIsoOfSurjective_hom_mk (f : H ⟶ K) (hf : Function.Surjective f.hom)
    (I : HopfIdeal R K) (x : H) :
    (quotientIsoOfSurjective f hf I).hom.hom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.comapOfSurjective f.hom hf).toIdeal x) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal (f.hom x)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_comp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma quotientMapOfLe_comp (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    {I J K : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (hJK : J ≤ K) :
    quotientMapOfLe H hIJ ≫ quotientMapOfLe H hJK =
      quotientMapOfLe H (hIJ.trans hJK)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_comp_liftQuotient_eq
statement:
lemma quotientMapOfLe_comp_liftQuotient_eq (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    {K : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R} {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : J.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker f.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom) (g : quotient H I ⟶ K)
    (hg : mkQuotient H I ≫ g = f) :
    quotientMapOfLe H hIJ ≫ liftQuotient J f hf = g

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_mk
statement:
lemma quotientMapOfLe_mk (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H}
    (hIJ : I ≤ J) (h : H) :
    (quotientMapOfLe H hIJ).hom (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J.toIdeal h

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_refl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma quotientMapOfLe_refl (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    quotientMapOfLe H (le_refl I) = 𝟙 (quotient H I)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_surjective
statement:
theorem quotientMapOfLe_surjective (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    Function.Surjective (quotientMapOfLe H hIJ).hom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.toIdeal_le_ker_mkQuotient_of_le
statement:
lemma toIdeal_le_ker_mkQuotient_of_le
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker (mkQuotient H J).hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.toIdeal_le_ker_of_mkQuotient_comp
TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_map_liftQuotient
statement:
lemma forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_map_liftQuotient (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker (toBialgHom f).toAlgHom.toRingHom) :
    (forget₂ (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)).map
      (liftQuotient I f hf) = CommHopfAlgCat.liftQuotient I f.hom hf

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_map_mkQuotient
statement:
lemma forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_map_mkQuotient (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    (forget₂ (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)).map
      (mkQuotient H I) = CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient H.obj I

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_map_quotientMapOfLe
statement:
lemma forget₂_commHopfAlgCat_map_quotientMapOfLe
    (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    (forget₂ (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)).map
        (quotientMapOfLe H hIJ) =
      CommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe H.obj hIJ

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.liftQuotient_unique
statement:
lemma liftQuotient_unique (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker (toBialgHom f).toAlgHom.toRingHom) (g : quotient H I ⟶ K)
    (hg : mkQuotient H I ≫ g = f) : g = liftQuotient I f hf

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.minimal_quotientProperty_comapOfIso
statement:
theorem minimal_quotientProperty_comapOfIso
    (P : ObjectProperty (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)) [P.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
    (I : HopfIdeal R K)
    (hI : Minimal (fun J : HopfIdeal R K ↦ P (quotient K J)) I) (e : H ≅ K) :
    Minimal (fun J : HopfIdeal R H ↦ P (quotient H J))
      (I.comapOfSurjective (toBialgHom e.hom)
        (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso e.hom).2)

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_eqToHom
statement:
theorem mkQuotient_comp_eqToHom {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I = J) :
    mkQuotient H J ≫ eqToHom (congrArg (quotient H) hIJ.symm) = mkQuotient H I

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_liftQuotient
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mkQuotient_comp_liftQuotient (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker (toBialgHom f).toAlgHom.toRingHom) :
    mkQuotient H I ≫ liftQuotient I f hf = f

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_quotientIsoOfIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mkQuotient_comp_quotientIsoOfIso_hom (e : H ≅ K) (I : HopfIdeal R K) :
    mkQuotient H
          (I.comapOfSurjective (toBialgHom e.hom) (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso e.hom).2) ≫
        (quotientIsoOfIso e I).hom =
      e.hom ≫ mkQuotient K I

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_quotientIsoOfIso_inv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mkQuotient_comp_quotientIsoOfIso_inv (e : H ≅ K) (I : HopfIdeal R K) :
    mkQuotient K I ≫ (quotientIsoOfIso e I).inv =
      e.inv ≫ mkQuotient H
        (I.comapOfSurjective (toBialgHom e.hom) (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso e.hom).2)

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_quotientMapOfLe
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mkQuotient_comp_quotientMapOfLe (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    mkQuotient H I ≫ quotientMapOfLe H hIJ = mkQuotient H J

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma mkQuotient_eq_zero_iff (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (h : H) : toBialgHom (mkQuotient H I) h = 0 ↔ h ∈ I.toIdeal

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_hom_ext
TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_ker
statement:
lemma mkQuotient_ker (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    RingHom.ker (toBialgHom (mkQuotient H I)).toAlgHom.toRingHom = I.toIdeal

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.quotientBotIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma quotientBotIso_hom (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) :
    (quotientBotIso H).hom =
      liftQuotient (⊥ : HopfIdeal R H) (𝟙 H) bot_le

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.quotientBotIso_inv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma quotientBotIso_inv (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) :
    (quotientBotIso H).inv = mkQuotient H (⊥ : HopfIdeal R H)

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_comp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma quotientMapOfLe_comp (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    {I J K : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (hJK : J ≤ K) :
    quotientMapOfLe H hIJ ≫ quotientMapOfLe H hJK =
      quotientMapOfLe H (hIJ.trans hJK)

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_mk
statement:
lemma quotientMapOfLe_mk (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (h : H) :
    (toBialgHom (quotientMapOfLe H hIJ)) (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J.toIdeal h

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_refl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma quotientMapOfLe_refl (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    quotientMapOfLe H (le_refl I) = 𝟙 (quotient H I)

name: TauCeti.FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.quotientMapOfLe_surjective
statement:
theorem quotientMapOfLe_surjective (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, v} R)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    Function.Surjective (toBialgHom (quotientMapOfLe H hIJ))

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective_eq_of_hom_le_of_inv_le
statement:
theorem comapOfSurjective_eq_of_hom_le_of_inv_le (e : H ≅ H) (I : HopfIdeal R H)
    (hhom : I.comapOfSurjective e.hom.hom (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso e.hom).2 ≤ I)
    (hinv : I.comapOfSurjective e.inv.hom (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso e.inv).2 ≤ I) :
    I.comapOfSurjective e.hom.hom (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso e.hom).2 = I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective_map_mkQuotient
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comapOfSurjective_map_mkQuotient {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    (J.map (Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom I.toIdeal)).comapOfSurjective
        (Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom I.toIdeal)
        (by
          intro q
          obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective q
          exact ⟨h, Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom_apply I.toIdeal h⟩) = J

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.liftQuotientPoint_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma liftQuotientPoint_mk (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (g : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H) A)
    (hg : ∀ h : H, h ∈ I → g.ofConv h = 0) (h : H) :
    ((liftQuotientPoint H I A g hg).ofConv) (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I.toIdeal h) =
      g.ofConv h

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.IsNormal.comapOfSurjective_of_bijective
statement:
theorem IsNormal.comapOfSurjective_of_bijective {I : HopfIdeal R K} (hI : I.IsNormal)
    (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hinj : Function.Injective f) (hsurj : Function.Surjective f) :
    (I.comapOfSurjective f hsurj).IsNormal

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.IsNormal.conjugation_mem
statement:
theorem IsNormal.conjugation_mem {I : HopfIdeal R H} (hI : I.IsNormal) {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    HopfAlgebra.conjugationAlgHom (R := R) (H := H) x ∈
      rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I.toIdeal

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.IsNormal.map
statement:
theorem IsNormal.map {K : Type w} [CommSemiring K] [HopfAlgebra R K]
    {I : HopfIdeal R H} (hI : I.IsNormal) (f : H →ₐc[R] K) :
    (I.map f).IsNormal

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.isNormal_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isNormal_bot : (⊥ : HopfIdeal R H).IsNormal

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.isNormal_def
statement:
theorem isNormal_def (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    I.IsNormal ↔
      Ideal.map (HopfAlgebra.conjugationAlgHom (R := R) (H := H)).toRingHom I.toIdeal ≤
        rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I.toIdeal

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.isNormal_iSup
statement:
theorem isNormal_iSup {i : Sort*} {I : i → HopfIdeal R H} (hI : ∀ j, (I j).IsNormal) :
    (⨆ j, I j).IsNormal

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.isNormal_iff_conjugation_mem
statement:
theorem isNormal_iff_conjugation_mem (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    I.IsNormal ↔ ∀ ⦃x : H⦄, x ∈ I →
      HopfAlgebra.conjugationAlgHom (R := R) (H := H) x ∈
        rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I.toIdeal

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.isNormal_normalCore
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isNormal_normalCore (J : HopfIdeal R H) : J.normalCore.IsNormal

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.isNormal_sSup
statement:
theorem isNormal_sSup {s : Set (HopfIdeal R H)} (hs : ∀ I ∈ s, I.IsNormal) :
    (sSup s).IsNormal

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.le_normalCore_iff_of_isNormal
statement:
theorem le_normalCore_iff_of_isNormal (I J : HopfIdeal R H) (hI : I.IsNormal) :
    I ≤ J.normalCore ↔ I ≤ J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.normalCore_eq_self_iff
statement: theorem normalCore_eq_self_iff (J : HopfIdeal R H) : J.normalCore = J ↔ J.IsNormal

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.normalCore_idempotent
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalCore_idempotent (J : HopfIdeal R H) : J.normalCore.normalCore = J.normalCore

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.normalCore_le
statement: theorem normalCore_le (J : HopfIdeal R H) : J.normalCore ≤ J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.normalCore_mono
statement:
theorem normalCore_mono {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    I.normalCore ≤ J.normalCore

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.isCentral_augmentation
statement:
theorem isCentral_augmentation (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) :
    (HopfIdeal.augmentation R ↥H).IsCentral

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.IsCentral.comapOfSurjective_of_bijective
statement:
theorem IsCentral.comapOfSurjective_of_bijective {H K : Type v} [CommRing H] [CommRing K]
    [HopfAlgebra R H] [HopfAlgebra R K] {I : HopfIdeal R K} (hI : I.IsCentral)
    (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hinj : Function.Injective f) (hsurj : Function.Surjective f) :

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.IsCentral.isCocomm_quotient
TauCeti.HopfIdeal.IsCentral.isNormal
statement:
theorem IsCentral.isNormal {H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R} {I : HopfIdeal R H}

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.IsCentral.mono
statement: theorem IsCentral.mono {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hI : I.IsCentral) (hIJ : I ≤ J) : J.IsCentral

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.isCentral_bot_iff_isCocomm
statement:
theorem isCentral_bot_iff_isCocomm :
    (⊥ : HopfIdeal R H).IsCentral ↔ _root_.Coalgebra.IsCocomm R H

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.isCentral_iSup_of_isCentral
statement:
theorem isCentral_iSup_of_isCentral {ι : Sort*} {I : ι → HopfIdeal R H} {j : ι}
    (hj : (I j).IsCentral) : (⨆ i, I i).IsCentral

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.eq_bot_of_comapOfSurjective_le
statement:
theorem eq_bot_of_comapOfSurjective_le {I : HopfIdeal R H} (J : HopfIdeal R (quotient H I))
    (hJ : HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective J (mkQuotient H I).hom (mkQuotient_surjective H I) ≤ I) :
    J = ⊥

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.comapOfSurjective_commonKernelHopfIdeal_le_of_comp_eq
statement:
theorem comapOfSurjective_commonKernelHopfIdeal_le_of_comp_eq {L : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R}
    (f : ι → (H ⟶ L)) (φ : H ⟶ H) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ.hom) (s : ι → ι)
    (hs : ∀ i, φ ≫ f (s i) = f i) :
    (commonKernelHopfIdeal f).comapOfSurjective φ.hom hφ ≤ commonKernelHopfIdeal f

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.comapOfSurjective_commonKernelHopfIdeal_le_of_comp_eq_comp
statement:
theorem comapOfSurjective_commonKernelHopfIdeal_le_of_comp_eq_comp
    (f : ∀ i, H ⟶ K i) (φ : H ⟶ H) (hφ : Function.Surjective φ.hom) (s : ι → ι)
    (m : ∀ i, K i ⟶ K (s i)) (hm : ∀ i, Function.Injective (m i).hom)
    (hs : ∀ i, φ ≫ f (s i) = f i ≫ m i) :
    (commonKernelHopfIdeal f).comapOfSurjective φ.hom hφ ≤ commonKernelHopfIdeal f

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.commonKernelHopfIdeal_commonKernelLift_eq_bot
statement:
theorem commonKernelHopfIdeal_commonKernelLift_eq_bot (f : ∀ i, H ⟶ K i) :
    commonKernelHopfIdeal (commonKernelLift f) = ⊥

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.commonKernelHopfIdeal_eq_map_mkQuotient_of_comp
statement:
theorem commonKernelHopfIdeal_eq_map_mkQuotient_of_comp (f : ∀ i, H ⟶ K i)
    (I : HopfIdeal R H) (c : ∀ i, quotient H I ⟶ K i)
    (hc : ∀ i, mkQuotient H I ≫ c i = f i) :
    commonKernelHopfIdeal c =
      (commonKernelHopfIdeal f).map (mkQuotient H I).hom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.commonKernelHopfIdeal_toIdeal_le_ker
statement:
theorem commonKernelHopfIdeal_toIdeal_le_ker (f : ∀ i, H ⟶ K i) (i : ι) :
    (commonKernelHopfIdeal f).toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker (f i).hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.commonKernelLift_surjective_of_surjective
statement:
theorem commonKernelLift_surjective_of_surjective (f : ∀ i, H ⟶ K i) (i : ι)
    (hi : Function.Surjective (f i).hom) :
    Function.Surjective (commonKernelLift f i).hom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.commonKernelLift_unique
statement:
theorem commonKernelLift_unique (f : ∀ i, H ⟶ K i) (i : ι)
    (g : quotient H (commonKernelHopfIdeal f) ⟶ K i)
    (hg : mkQuotient H (commonKernelHopfIdeal f) ≫ g = f i) :
    g = commonKernelLift f i

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.le_commonKernelHopfIdeal_iff
statement:
theorem le_commonKernelHopfIdeal_iff (f : ∀ i, H ⟶ K i) (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    I ≤ commonKernelHopfIdeal f ↔
      ∀ i, I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker (f i).hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_commonKernelLift
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkQuotient_comp_commonKernelLift (f : ∀ i, H ⟶ K i) (i : ι) :
    mkQuotient H (commonKernelHopfIdeal f) ≫ commonKernelLift f i = f i

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeHopfIdeal_augmentation
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeHopfIdeal_augmentation :
    baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) (HopfIdeal.augmentation k H) =
      HopfIdeal.augmentation K (baseChange (K := K) H)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeHopfIdeal_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeHopfIdeal_bot :
    baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) (⊥ : HopfIdeal k H) = ⊥

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeHopfIdeal_comapOfIso
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeHopfIdeal_comapOfIso (J : HopfIdeal k L) (e : H ≅ L) :
    baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K)
        (J.comapOfSurjective e.hom.hom (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso e.hom).2) =
      (baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J).comapOfSurjective
        (baseChangeMap (K := K) e.hom).hom
        (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
          ((baseChangeFunctor (K := K)).mapIso e).hom).2

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeHopfIdeal_commonKernelHopfIdeal_le
statement:
theorem baseChangeHopfIdeal_commonKernelHopfIdeal_le (f : ∀ i, H ⟶ N i) :
    baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) (commonKernelHopfIdeal f) ≤
      commonKernelHopfIdeal fun i ↦ baseChangeMap (K := K) (f i)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeHopfIdeal_injective
statement:
theorem baseChangeHopfIdeal_injective :
    Function.Injective
      (baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) : HopfIdeal k H → HopfIdeal K (baseChange (K := K) H))

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeHopfIdeal_le_iff
statement:
theorem baseChangeHopfIdeal_le_iff (halg : Function.Injective (algebraMap k K))
    {J J' : HopfIdeal k H} [Module.Flat k (CommHopfAlgCat.quotient H J')] :
    baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J ≤ baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J' ↔ J ≤ J'

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeHopfIdeal_le_iff_of_faithfullyFlat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeHopfIdeal_le_iff_of_faithfullyFlat (J J' : HopfIdeal k H) :
    baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J ≤ baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J' ↔ J ≤ J'

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeHopfIdeal_mono
statement:
theorem baseChangeHopfIdeal_mono {J J' : HopfIdeal k H} (hJ : J ≤ J') :
    baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J ≤ baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J'

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeHopfIdeal_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeHopfIdeal_toIdeal (J : HopfIdeal k H) :
    (baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J).toIdeal =
      J.toIdeal.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : H →ₐ[k] K ⊗[k] H)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeHopfIdeal_toIdeal_le_ker_baseChangeMap
statement:
theorem baseChangeHopfIdeal_toIdeal_le_ker_baseChangeMap {N : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k}
    (J : HopfIdeal k H) (f : H ⟶ N) (hJ : J.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker f.hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom) :
    (baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J).toIdeal ≤
      RingHom.ker (baseChangeMap (K := K) f).hom.toAlgHom.toRingHom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeMap_mkQuotient_comp_quotientBaseChangeIsoOfMapEq_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeMap_mkQuotient_comp_quotientBaseChangeIsoOfMapEq_hom
    {H' : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{max w v} K} (J : HopfIdeal k H) (J' : HopfIdeal K H')
    (e : baseChange (K := K) H ≅ H')
    (hJ : (baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J).map e.hom.hom = J') :
    baseChangeMap (K := K) (mkQuotient H J) ≫
        (quotientBaseChangeIsoOfMapEq J J' e hJ).hom =
      e.hom ≫ mkQuotient H' J'

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.isCentral_baseChangeHopfIdeal
statement:
theorem isCentral_baseChangeHopfIdeal {J : HopfIdeal k H} (hJ : J.IsCentral) :
    (baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J).IsCentral

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.map_baseChangeHopfIdeal_kerOfSurjective
statement:
theorem map_baseChangeHopfIdeal_kerOfSurjective
    {T : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k} {H' T' : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{max w v} K}
    (e : baseChange (K := K) H ≅ H') (t : baseChange (K := K) T ≅ T')
    {f : H ⟶ T} (hf : Function.Surjective f.hom) {f' : H' ⟶ T'}
    (hf' : Function.Surjective f'.hom)
    (hbase : e.inv ≫ baseChangeMap (K := K) f ≫ t.hom = f') :
    (baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) (HopfIdeal.kerOfSurjective f.hom hf)).map e.hom.hom =
      HopfIdeal.kerOfSurjective f'.hom hf'

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.map_baseChangeHopfIdeal_of_quotientIso
statement:
theorem map_baseChangeHopfIdeal_of_quotientIso
    {T : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k} {H' T' : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{max w v} K}
    (J : HopfIdeal k H) (J' : HopfIdeal K H')
    (e : baseChange (K := K) H ≅ H') (t : baseChange (K := K) T ≅ T')
    (q : quotient H J ≅ T) {f : H ⟶ T} {f' : H' ⟶ T'}
    (hq : mkQuotient H J ≫ q.hom = f)
    (hf' : e.inv ≫ baseChangeMap (K := K) f ≫ t.hom = f')
    (hJ' : ∀ x, x ∈ J' ↔ f'.hom x = 0) :
    (baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J).map e.hom.hom = J'

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.map_baseChangeHopfIdeal_of_toIdeal_eq_span
statement:
theorem map_baseChangeHopfIdeal_of_toIdeal_eq_span
    {H' : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{max w v} K} {S : Set H} {S' : Set H'}
    (J : HopfIdeal k H) (J' : HopfIdeal K H') (e : baseChange (K := K) H ≅ H')
    (hJ : J.toIdeal = Ideal.span S) (hJ' : J'.toIdeal = Ideal.span S')
    (h : (fun x : H => e.hom.hom ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[k] x)) '' S = S') :
    (baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J).map e.hom.hom = J'

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mem_baseChangeHopfIdeal_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_baseChangeHopfIdeal_iff (J : HopfIdeal k H) (y : baseChange (K := K) H) :
    y ∈ baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J ↔ (baseChangeMap (K := K) (mkQuotient H J)).hom y = 0

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_quotientBaseChangeIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkQuotient_comp_quotientBaseChangeIso_hom (J : HopfIdeal k H) :
    mkQuotient (baseChange (K := K) H) (baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J) ≫
        (quotientBaseChangeIso (K := K) J).hom =
      baseChangeMap (K := K) (mkQuotient H J)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.one_tmul_mem_baseChangeHopfIdeal
statement:
theorem one_tmul_mem_baseChangeHopfIdeal {J : HopfIdeal k H} {h : H} (hh : h ∈ J) :
    (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[k] h ∈ baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.quotientBaseChangeIso_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem quotientBaseChangeIso_hom_apply (J : HopfIdeal k H) (y : baseChange (K := K) H) :
    (quotientBaseChangeIso (K := K) J).hom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J).toIdeal y) =
      (baseChangeMap (K := K) (mkQuotient H J)).hom y

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.tmul_mem_baseChangeHopfIdeal
statement:
theorem tmul_mem_baseChangeHopfIdeal {J : HopfIdeal k H} (s : K) {h : H} (hh : h ∈ J) :
    s ⊗ₜ[k] h ∈ baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) J

name: TauCeti.smoothCommHopfAlgProperty_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma smoothCommHopfAlgProperty_iff {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (H : CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) :
    smoothCommHopfAlgProperty R H ↔ Algebra.Smooth R H

name: Subgroup.mem_of_adjacent_of_commutator
statement:
theorem mem_of_adjacent_of_commutator (H : Subgroup G)
    (x : ∀ {i j : Fin m}, i ≠ j → P → G)
    (hcomm : ∀ {i j k : Fin m} (hij : i ≠ j) (hjk : j ≠ k) (hik : i ≠ k) (a : P),
      ⁅x hij a, x hjk 1⁆ = x hik a)
    (hadjacent : ∀ {i j : Fin m} (hij : i ≠ j) (a : P),

name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLikeSetSpan_eq_top_iff_of_coalgEquiv

name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLikeSetSpan_finite

name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLikeSetSpan_le

name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLikeSetSpan_toSubmodule

name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLikeSpan_le
statement:
theorem groupLikeSpan_le {g : GroupLike R C} {D : Subcoalgebra R C} :
    groupLikeSpan (R := R) (C := C) g ≤ D ↔ (g : C) ∈ D

name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLikeSpan_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupLikeSpan_toSubmodule (g : GroupLike R C) :
    (groupLikeSpan (R := R) (C := C) g).toSubmodule = R ∙ (g : C)

name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLike_mem_groupLikeSetSpan

theorem groupLike_mem_groupLikeSetSpan {s : Set (GroupLike R C)} {g : GroupLike R C} (hg : g ∈ s) :

name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.groupLike_mem_groupLikeSpan

name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.mem_groupLikeSetSpan

name: TauCeti.Subcoalgebra.mem_groupLikeSpan

name: TauCeti.GroupLike.mapEquiv_symm

name: TauCeti.GroupLike.mapEquiv_trans

theorem mapEquiv_trans {C : Type*} [Semiring C] [Bialgebra R C]

name: TauCeti.GroupLike.map_comp

name: TauCeti.GroupLike.map_id

name: TauCeti.GroupLike.val_map

theorem val_map (f : A →ₐc[R] B) (x : _root_.GroupLike R A) :

name: TauCeti.GroupLike.val_mapEquiv
statement:
@[simp]

name: Additive.ofMul_smul

    (x : Additive (_root_.GroupLike (AlgebraicClosure k) (AlgebraicClosure k ⊗[k] A))) :

statement:

    additiveCharacterMap f (sigma • x) = sigma • additiveCharacterMap f x

    (geometricCharacterFunctor (k := k)).map f =
      eqToHom (geometricCharacterFunctor_obj H) ≫ geometricCharacterRepresentationMap f ≫
        eqToHom (geometricCharacterFunctor_obj K).symm

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.geometricCharacterFunctor_obj

    (geometricCharacterFunctor (k := k)).obj H = geometricCharacterRepresentation H

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.geometricCharacterMap_comp
statement:

theorem geometricCharacterMap_comp {H K L : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} k}
    (f : H ⟶ K) (g : K ⟶ L) :
    geometricCharacterMap (f ≫ g) = (geometricCharacterMap g).comp (geometricCharacterMap f)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.geometricCharacterMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem geometricCharacterMap_id (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} k) :
    geometricCharacterMap (𝟙 H) = MonoidHom.id (geometricCharacterGroup H)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.geometricCharacterMap_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem geometricCharacterMap_smul {H K : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} k} (f : H ⟶ K)
    (sigma : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup k) (x : geometricCharacterGroup H) :
    geometricCharacterMap f (sigma • x) = sigma • geometricCharacterMap f x

    (geometricCharacterRepresentationMap f).hom x = additiveCharacterMap f x

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.geometricCharacterRepresentation_ρ_apply
statement:
theorem geometricCharacterRepresentation_ρ_apply (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} k)
    (sigma : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup k) (x : additiveCharacterGroup H) :
    (geometricCharacterRepresentation H).ρ sigma x = sigma • x

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.toMul_additiveCharacterMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toMul_additiveCharacterMap {H K : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} k} (f : H ⟶ K)

    (additiveCharacterMap f x).toMul = geometricCharacterMap f x.toMul

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.val_geometricCharacterMap
statement:

theorem val_geometricCharacterMap {H K : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} k} (f : H ⟶ K)

    (geometricCharacterMap f x).val =
      (baseChangeMap (K := AlgebraicClosure k) f).hom x.val

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.grpObjMap_productMapOfNormal
statement:
theorem grpObjMap_productMapOfNormal
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} R) (I J : HopfIdeal R H)
    (hI : I.IsNormal) :
    let i := quotientGrpObjInclusion H I
    let j := quotientGrpObjInclusion H J
    let _ : IsMonHom.Normal i := (quotientGrpObjInclusion_normal_iff H I).2 hI
    grpObjMap (normalSemidirectProductIso H I J hI).hom ≫
      grpObjMap (productMapOfNormal H I J hI) =
      (GrpObj.Action.normalSemidirectMul i j).hom.hom

          (MulEquiv.ulift.symm.toMonoidHom.comp

-- Not `@[simp]`: its left-hand side subsumes that of the `@[simp]` elimination lemma
-- `coordinateMap_relationMatrix`, and the raw quotient-class form is not the normal form —

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.le_derivedDefiningIdeal_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem le_derivedDefiningIdeal_iff (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    I ≤ derivedDefiningIdeal (R := R) H ↔
      I.toIdeal ≤
        RingHom.ker (HopfAlgebra.commutatorAlgHom (R := R) (H := H)).toRingHom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeHopfIdeal_derivedDefiningIdeal_le
statement:
theorem baseChangeHopfIdeal_derivedDefiningIdeal_le
    (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k) :
    baseChangeHopfIdeal (K := K) (derivedDefiningIdeal (R := k) H) ≤
      derivedDefiningIdeal (R := K) (baseChange (K := K) H)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.derivedDefiningIdeal_map_le
statement:
theorem derivedDefiningIdeal_map_le (f : H →ₐc[R] K) :
    (derivedDefiningIdeal (R := R) H).map f ≤ derivedDefiningIdeal (R := R) K

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.derivedFunctor_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedFunctor_map (f : H ⟶ K) :
    (derivedFunctor (R := R)).map f =
      eqToHom (derivedFunctor_obj H) ≫ derivedMap f ≫
        eqToHom (derivedFunctor_obj K).symm

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.derivedFunctor_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedFunctor_obj (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) :
    (derivedFunctor (R := R)).obj H = quotient H (derivedDefiningIdeal (R := R) H)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.derivedMap_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedMap_comp (f : H ⟶ K) (g : K ⟶ L) :
    derivedMap (f ≫ g) = derivedMap f ≫ derivedMap g

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.derivedMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedMap_id (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) :
    derivedMap (𝟙 H) = 𝟙 (quotient H (derivedDefiningIdeal (R := R) H))

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.derivedMap_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedMap_mk (f : H ⟶ K) (x : H) :
    (derivedMap f).hom
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (derivedDefiningIdeal (R := R) H).toIdeal x) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (derivedDefiningIdeal (R := R) K).toIdeal (f.hom x)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.derivedQuotientNatTrans_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem derivedQuotientNatTrans_app (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R) :
    (derivedQuotientNatTrans (R := R)).app H =
      mkQuotient H (derivedDefiningIdeal (R := R) H) ≫
        eqToHom (derivedFunctor_obj H).symm

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.mkQuotient_comp_derivedMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkQuotient_comp_derivedMap (f : H ⟶ K) :
    mkQuotient H (derivedDefiningIdeal (R := R) H) ≫ derivedMap f =
      f ≫ mkQuotient K (derivedDefiningIdeal (R := R) K)

name: LinearMap.tensorComponent_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorComponent_map {M' : Type x} {N' : Type y}
    [AddCommMonoid M'] [Module R M'] [AddCommMonoid N'] [Module R N']
    (phi : N' →ₗ[R] R) (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (g : N →ₗ[R] N') (t : M ⊗[R] N) :
    tensorComponent phi (TensorProduct.map f g t) =
      f (tensorComponent (phi.comp g) t)

name: LinearMap.tensorComponent_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorComponent_tmul (phi : N →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) (n : N) :
    tensorComponent (R := R) (M := M) phi (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) = phi n • m

name: LinearMap.tensorComponent_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorComponent_zero :
    tensorComponent (R := R) (M := M) (0 : N →ₗ[R] R) = 0

name: Module.Basis.eq_baseChange_repr_tmul_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem eq_baseChange_repr_tmul_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton ι] (b : Basis ι R M)
    (z : S ⊗[R] M) (i : ι) :
    z = (b.baseChange S).repr z i ⊗ₜ b i

name: Module.Basis.map_baseChange_repr
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_baseChange_repr (b : Basis ι R M) (φ : S →ₗ[R] T)
    (z : S ⊗[R] M) (i : ι) :
    φ ((b.baseChange S).repr z i) =
      (b.baseChange T).repr
        (TensorProduct.map φ LinearMap.id z) i

name: Module.Basis.map_toMatrixAlgEquiv_baseChange
statement:
theorem map_toMatrixAlgEquiv_baseChange (b : Basis ι R M) (φ : S →ₐ[R] T)
    (f : S ⊗[R] M →ₗ[S] S ⊗[R] M) (g : T ⊗[R] M →ₗ[T] T ⊗[R] M)
    (h : ∀ z, TensorProduct.map φ.toLinearMap LinearMap.id (f z) =
      g (TensorProduct.map φ.toLinearMap LinearMap.id z)) :
    (LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv (b.baseChange S) f).map φ =
      LinearMap.toMatrixAlgEquiv (b.baseChange T) g

name: Module.Basis.toMatrix_baseChange_baseChange
statement:
theorem toMatrix_baseChange_baseChange (b : Basis ι R M) (f : M →ₗ[R] M) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (b.baseChange S) (b.baseChange S) (f.baseChange S) =
      (LinearMap.toMatrix b b f).map (algebraMap R S)

name: TensorProduct.tensor_eq_of_forall_tensorComponent_eq
statement:
theorem tensor_eq_of_forall_tensorComponent_eq [Module.Projective R N] {x y : M ⊗[R] N}
    (h : ∀ φ : Module.Dual R N,
      _root_.LinearMap.tensorComponent (R := R) (M := M) φ x =
        _root_.LinearMap.tensorComponent (R := R) (M := M) φ y) :
    x = y

name: TauCeti.tensor_eq_zero_of_forall_lid_map_eq_zero
statement:
theorem tensor_eq_zero_of_forall_lid_map_eq_zero
    {k M N ι κ : Type*} [Field k] [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module k N]
    (f : ι → M →ₗ[k] k) (g : κ → N →ₗ[k] k)
    (hf : ∀ m, (∀ i, f i m = 0) → m = 0)
    (hg : ∀ n, (∀ j, g j n = 0) → n = 0)
    (x : M ⊗[k] N)
    (hx : ∀ i j, TensorProduct.lid k k (TensorProduct.map (f i) (g j) x) = 0) :
    x = 0

name: TauCeti.tensor_eq_zero_of_forall_lid_rTensor_eq_zero
statement:
theorem tensor_eq_zero_of_forall_lid_rTensor_eq_zero
    {k M N ι : Type*} [Field k] [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module k N]
    (f : ι → M →ₗ[k] k) (hf : ∀ m, (∀ i, f i m = 0) → m = 0)
    (x : M ⊗[k] N)
    (hx : ∀ i, TensorProduct.lid k N ((f i).rTensor N x) = 0) :
    x = 0

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.isReduced_quotient_derivedDefiningIdeal

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.isReduced_quotient_derivedDefiningIdeal_of_isReduced_tensorProduct
statement:
theorem isReduced_quotient_derivedDefiningIdeal_of_isReduced_tensorProduct
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)
    [IsReduced (H ⊗[R] H)]

      ((quotient H (derivedDefiningIdeal H) ⧸ nilradical (quotient H (derivedDefiningIdeal H))) ⊗[R]
        (quotient H (derivedDefiningIdeal H) ⧸ nilradical (quotient H (derivedDefiningIdeal H))))] :

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.smoothCommHopfAlgProperty_quotient_derivedDefiningIdeal
statement:
theorem smoothCommHopfAlgProperty_quotient_derivedDefiningIdeal :

name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.groupLikeEquiv_apply_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupLikeEquiv_apply_eq_iff [CommRing R]
    [ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum R)] {H : Type w} [Monoid H]
    (x : _root_.GroupLike R (_root_.MonoidAlgebra R H)) (h : H) :
    groupLikeEquiv (R := R) x = h ↔
      x.val = _root_.MonoidAlgebra.single h 1

name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.groupLikeSetSpan_eq_top
statement:
theorem groupLikeSetSpan_eq_top [CommSemiring R] (G : Type v) :
    Subcoalgebra.groupLikeSetSpan (R := R) (C := _root_.MonoidAlgebra R G) Set.univ = ⊤

name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.isGroupLikeElem_iff_eq_single
statement:
theorem isGroupLikeElem_iff_eq_single [CommRing R]
    [ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum R)] {H : Type v} [Monoid H]
    (x : _root_.MonoidAlgebra R H) :
    IsGroupLikeElem R x ↔
      ∃! h : H, x = _root_.MonoidAlgebra.single h 1

name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHomPreimage_apply_eq_iff
statement:
theorem mapDomainBialgHomPreimage_apply_eq_iff [CommRing R]
    [ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum R)] {G : Type v} {H : Type w}
    [Monoid G] [Monoid H]
    (F : _root_.MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐc[R] _root_.MonoidAlgebra R H)
    (g : G) (h : H) :
    mapDomainBialgHomPreimage R F g = h ↔
      F (_root_.MonoidAlgebra.single g 1) = _root_.MonoidAlgebra.single h 1

name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHomPreimage_mapDomainBialgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapDomainBialgHomPreimage_mapDomainBialgHom [CommRing R]
    [ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum R)] {G : Type v} {H : Type w}
    [Monoid G] [Monoid H] (φ : G →* H) :
    mapDomainBialgHomPreimage R (_root_.MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom R φ) = φ

name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHomPreimage_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapDomainBialgHomPreimage_single [CommRing R]
    [ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum R)] {G : Type v} {H : Type w}
    [Monoid G] [Monoid H]
    (F : _root_.MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐc[R] _root_.MonoidAlgebra R H) (g : G) :
    F (_root_.MonoidAlgebra.single g 1) =
      _root_.MonoidAlgebra.single (mapDomainBialgHomPreimage R F g) 1

name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom_injective
statement:
theorem mapDomainBialgHom_injective [CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R]
    {G : Type v} {H : Type w} [Monoid G] [Monoid H] :
    Function.Injective (_root_.MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom R :
      (G →* H) →
        (_root_.MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐc[R] _root_.MonoidAlgebra R H))

name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom_mapDomainBialgHomPreimage
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapDomainBialgHom_mapDomainBialgHomPreimage [CommRing R]
    [ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum R)] {G : Type v} {H : Type w}
    [Monoid G] [Monoid H]
    (F : _root_.MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐc[R] _root_.MonoidAlgebra R H) :
    _root_.MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom R (mapDomainBialgHomPreimage R F) = F

name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom_surjective
statement:
theorem mapDomainBialgHom_surjective [CommRing R]
    [ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum R)] {G : Type v} {H : Type w}

    Function.Surjective (_root_.MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom R :

        (_root_.MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐc[R] _root_.MonoidAlgebra R H))

name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.val_groupLikeEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem val_groupLikeEquiv_symm [CommRing R]
    [ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum R)] {H : Type w} [Monoid H] (h : H) :
    ((groupLikeEquiv (R := R) (H := H)).symm h).val =
      _root_.MonoidAlgebra.single h 1

name: TauCeti.CommGrpCat.isFG_iff
statement:

theorem isFG_iff (G : CommGrpCat.{v}) :

name: TauCeti.FGCommGrpCat.hom_ext
TauCeti.FGCommGrpCat.ofHom_toMonoidHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofHom_toMonoidHom {G H : FGCommGrpCat.{v}} (φ : G ⟶ H) :

name: TauCeti.FGCommGrpCat.toMonoidHom_comp

theorem toMonoidHom_comp {G H K : FGCommGrpCat.{v}} (φ : G ⟶ H) (ψ : H ⟶ K) :

statement:
@[simp]
theorem toMonoidHom_id {G : FGCommGrpCat.{v}} :

name: TauCeti.FGCommGrpCat.toMonoidHom_ofHom

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.coordinateMapPreimage_apply_eq_iff
statement:
theorem coordinateMapPreimage_apply_eq_iff [ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum R)]
    {G H : FGCommGrpCat.{v}} (F : coordinateRing R G ⟶ coordinateRing R H)
    (g : G) (h : H) :
    FGCommGrpCat.toMonoidHom (coordinateMapPreimage R F) g = h ↔
      FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom F (MonoidAlgebra.single g 1) =
        MonoidAlgebra.single h 1

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.coordinateMapPreimage_coordinateMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateMapPreimage_coordinateMap [ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum R)]
    {G H : FGCommGrpCat.{v}} (φ : G ⟶ H) :
    coordinateMapPreimage R (coordinateMap R φ) = φ

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.coordinateMapPreimage_single
statement:

theorem coordinateMapPreimage_single [ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum R)]
    {G H : FGCommGrpCat.{v}}
    (F : coordinateRing R G ⟶ coordinateRing R H) (g : G) :
    FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom F (MonoidAlgebra.single g 1) =
      MonoidAlgebra.single
        (FGCommGrpCat.toMonoidHom (coordinateMapPreimage R F) g) 1

theorem coordinateRingFunctor_map {G H : FGCommGrpCat.{v}} (φ : G ⟶ H) :

statement:

name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom_comp_scalarTensorBialgEquiv
statement:
theorem mapDomainBialgHom_comp_scalarTensorBialgEquiv (φ : G →* G') :
    (_root_.MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom K φ).comp
        (scalarTensorBialgEquiv k K (G := G) :
          K ⊗[k] _root_.MonoidAlgebra k G →ₐc[K] _root_.MonoidAlgebra K G) =
      (scalarTensorBialgEquiv k K (G := G') :
          K ⊗[k] _root_.MonoidAlgebra k G' →ₐc[K] _root_.MonoidAlgebra K G').comp
        (_root_.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.map (_root_.BialgHom.id K K)
          (_root_.MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom k φ))

name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.scalarTensorBialgEquiv_symm_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scalarTensorBialgEquiv_symm_single (g : G) (s : K) :
    (scalarTensorBialgEquiv k K).symm (_root_.MonoidAlgebra.single g s) =
      s ⊗ₜ[k] _root_.MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : k)

name: TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.scalarTensorBialgEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scalarTensorBialgEquiv_tmul (s : K) (p : _root_.MonoidAlgebra k G) :
    scalarTensorBialgEquiv k K (s ⊗ₜ[k] p) =
      s • _root_.MonoidAlgebra.mapAlgHom G (Algebra.ofId k K) p

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.baseChangeCoordinateHopfAlgebraIso_hom_apply
statement:
-- Not `@[simp]`: `simp` rewrites the left-hand side through `Functor.mapIso_hom` and
-- `ObjectProperty.ι_map` into the `baseChangeCoordinateRingIso` spelling, so this equation is
-- stated for `rw` in goals phrased with the `CommHopfAlgCat`-level isomorphism.
theorem baseChangeCoordinateHopfAlgebraIso_hom_apply
    (k : Type u) (K : Type v) [CommRing k] [CommRing K] [Algebra k K]
    (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) (x : K ⊗[k] MonoidAlgebra k G) :
    (baseChangeCoordinateHopfAlgebraIso k K G).hom.hom x =
      TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.scalarTensorBialgEquiv k K x

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply
    (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] MonoidAlgebra k G →ₐ[K] A)) :
    baseChangePointsMulEquiv f =
      charOfPoint
        (((AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K)
          (A := MonoidAlgebra k G) (R := A)).symm f).ofConv)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply_coe
    (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] MonoidAlgebra k G →ₐ[K] A)) (g : G) :
    (baseChangePointsMulEquiv f g : A) =
      f.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : k))

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain
statement:
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain (φ : G →* G')
    (f : WithConv (K ⊗[k] MonoidAlgebra k G' →ₐ[K] A)) :
    baseChangePointsMulEquiv
        (AlgHom.mapDomain (A := A)
          (_root_.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.map (_root_.BialgHom.id K K)
            (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom k φ)) f) =
      (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (G := G') f).comp φ

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain_scalarTensorBialgEquiv
statement:
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_mapDomain_scalarTensorBialgEquiv
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra K G →ₐ[K] A)) :
    baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (G := G)
        (AlgHom.mapDomain (A := A)
          (TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.scalarTensorBialgEquiv k K (G := G) :
            K ⊗[k] MonoidAlgebra k G →ₐc[K] MonoidAlgebra K G) f) =
      pointsMulEquiv (R := K) (A := A) (G := G) f

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_single_one
statement:
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_single_one (χ : G →* Aˣ) (g : G) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (G := G)).symm χ).ofConv
        (1 ⊗ₜ[k] MonoidAlgebra.single g (1 : k)) =
      (χ g : A)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul_single (χ : G →* Aˣ) (s : K)
    (g : G) (r : k) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (G := G)).symm χ).ofConv
        (s ⊗ₜ[k] MonoidAlgebra.single g r) =
      s • (r • (χ g : A))

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.mapDomain_baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem mapDomain_baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (φ : G →* G') (χ : G' →* Aˣ) :
    AlgHom.mapDomain (A := A)
        (_root_.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.map (_root_.BialgHom.id K K)
          (MonoidAlgebra.mapDomainBialgHom k φ))
        ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (G := G')).symm χ) =
      (baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (G := G)).symm (χ.comp φ)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.geometricCharacterGroupEquivOfIso_apply_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem geometricCharacterGroupEquivOfIso_apply_eq_iff
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, u} k)
    (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u})
    (i : DiagonalizableGroup.coordinateRing (AlgebraicClosure k) G ≅
      FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.baseChange (K := AlgebraicClosure k) H)
    (x : geometricCharacterGroup H.obj) (g : G) :
    geometricCharacterGroupEquivOfIso k H G i x = g ↔
      i.inv.hom x.val = _root_.MonoidAlgebra.single g 1

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.geometricCharacterGroupEquiv_apply_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem geometricCharacterGroupEquiv_apply_eq_iff
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u})
    (x : CommHopfAlgCat.geometricCharacterGroup (coordinateRing k G).obj) (g : G) :
    geometricCharacterGroupEquiv k G x = g ↔
      TauCeti.MonoidAlgebra.scalarTensorBialgEquiv k (AlgebraicClosure k) x.val =
        _root_.MonoidAlgebra.single g 1

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.geometricCharacterGroupEquiv_symm_apply_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem geometricCharacterGroupEquiv_symm_apply_val
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) (g : G) :
    ((geometricCharacterGroupEquiv k G).symm g).val =
      1 ⊗ₜ[k] _root_.MonoidAlgebra.single g 1

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.smul_geometricCharacterGroup_eq_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_geometricCharacterGroup_eq_self (k : Type u) [Field k] (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u})
    (σ : Field.absoluteGaloisGroup k)
    (x : CommHopfAlgCat.geometricCharacterGroup (coordinateRing k G).obj) :
    σ • x = x

name: TauCeti.GroupLike.fg_of_finiteType_of_groupLikeSetSpan_eq_top
statement:
theorem fg_of_finiteType_of_groupLikeSetSpan_eq_top
    (R : Type u) (H : Type v) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [Ring H] [HopfAlgebra R H]

name: TauCeti.GroupLike.fg_of_finiteType_of_linearIndependent_of_groupLikeSetSpan_eq_top
statement:
theorem fg_of_finiteType_of_linearIndependent_of_groupLikeSetSpan_eq_top
    (R : Type u) (H : Type v) [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] [Semiring H] [HopfAlgebra R H]
    (hfinite : Algebra.FiniteType R H)
